status: not-run as a set. Nothing here is a measured misroute rate.
use: Copy `cases` into a westack-eval routing campaign (kind routing) and register it before any description is tuned. The split is fixed here: score the held-out cases once per description version; scoring them against a changed description turns them into dev cases.
invocation: westack-orchestrate is manual only (disable-model-invocation: true). Only a typed `/westack-orchestrate` should reach it, so every positive case starts with that command. A request for parallel workers that does not invoke the skill must route to the sibling that owns the work (build, plan, review, debug), to an outside skill the user names, or to nothing: a host that loads westack-orchestrate on such a request is a finding, not a pass. A request that names the skill in prose is not an invocation either (o07 and o08 expect NONE); if a host loads it there, record what the host did, because that is a host-behaviour observation, not a description problem.
population_needed: Names in `expect` must be in the campaign's population: westack-orchestrate, westack-build, westack-plan, westack-review and westack-debug from this repository, plus the superpowers plugin's `superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents` and `superpowers:subagent-driven-development`, the likeliest competitors for a request to fan out. Keep westack-orchestrate in the population as a manual-only skill: it is listed but never model-invoked. Requests with no owner in the population expect NONE.
